article.title: Contraste y tópicos múltiples en mandarín
article.part: Información y discurso avanzado — 信息與進階篇章
article.chapter: Tema, foco, elipsis y cadenas referenciales — 主題、焦點、省略與指稱鏈

claims.summary: Chou (2025) reports that, for some native speakers, multiple gapped DP topicalization can be acceptable under a contrastive interpretation in a contextual question–answer setting. The article treats this as a limited judgment, not a general discourse chain, and explicitly leaves the broader interaction for future work.

locator.passage: §2.1 Contrastivity, ejemplos (5)–(7), HTML lines 92–101: report that multiple gapped DP topicalization is acceptable for some native speakers with contrastive interpretation; line 101 states the interplay is set aside for future work.

links.notes: La entrada fue restringida a la afirmación y al alcance expresamente publicados; las generalizaciones y ejemplos previos sin fuente se retiraron.
